attacks.name: Chi Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Flying Kick
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

attacks.name: The Iron Fist
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 3 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender has an Activated token, it gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition and is thrown |!range_small| away from this character. If the defender does not have an Activated token, it gains an Activated token.

superPowers.name: Immortal Weapon
superPowers.body: During the Power Phase, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Master Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 3, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
